gloss: big splurge; great effort; generous spending

definitions.gloss: big splurge; generous expenditure; going all out financially
definitions.explanation: Spending a notably large amount of money on something, often more than one normally would, as a special treat or generous gesture.

definitions.gloss: great effort; vigorous exertion; going all out
definitions.explanation: Putting in an extraordinary amount of effort or energy to accomplish something.

notes:
Compound of {大|だい} ('great; big') and ⟦{奮発|ふんぱつ}→奮発：15756_funpatsu⟧ ('exertion; splurging'). An emphatic version of ⟦{奮発|ふんぱつ}→奮発：15756_funpatsu⟧, which itself means both 'to splurge' and 'to exert oneself.' The financial sense (splurging) is more common in everyday conversation.

USAGE:
- Usually used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {大奮発|だいふんぱつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ('to splurge big; to go all out').
- In the spending sense, implies the person is treating themselves or others to something beyond their usual budget — a festive, generous, somewhat playful tone.
- The effort sense is used in sports, business, and academic contexts to praise exceptional exertion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大奮発|だいふんぱつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to splurge and buy
- {大奮発|だいふんぱつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to splurge on a meal
- {大奮発|だいふんぱつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to go all out (financially or in effort)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{奮発|ふんぱつ}→奮発：15756_funpatsu⟧: splurge; exertion — the base form without the intensifier {大|だい}
- ⟦{散財|さんざい}→散財：09233_sanzai⟧: extravagant spending — focuses on the wasteful aspect of spending money
- ⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧: luxury; extravagance — describes the quality of what is consumed rather than the act of spending
- {張|は}り{込|こ}む: to go big; to splash out — a more colloquial expression for spending generously
